slug: 天行健君子以自强不息
content_zh:
天青城的冬天，向来来得早。
猝不及防，寒刺骨血。
城西破败土地庙的门槛上，林天行孤身蹲着。掌心半块窝头干硬硌手，早已凉透。
他抬眼，凝望头顶沉沉压下的铅灰天穹。
十一月朔风穿破断墙，直灌衣襟。寒风刮得面皮生疼，身上单薄单衣根本抵御不住凛冽寒意。他死死蜷缩身躯，竭力锁住周身仅存的暖意。
年方十五，他生得格外瘦小单薄，像一株在寒冬里勉强苟活的荒草，弱不禁风。
“天行！”
巷口骤然炸开一声急促呼喊，是邻居刘婶，语调慌得发颤。
林天行猛然抬头，只见裹着厚棉袄的刘婶踉跄奔来，眼底慌乱藏之不住。他心头骤然一沉。
“快回！你家出事了！”
窝头脱手落地，滚入泥泞。林天行无暇顾及，拔腿疯冲向城东贫民巷。
他家两间土坯房墙皮剥落、破败不堪。此刻屋外围满邻里，人群死寂，气氛压抑得诡异。
众人见他奔来，默默让出一条窄道。
林天行冲进门，脚步瞬间钉死，浑身僵冷。
屋内狼藉遍地。
旧木桌倒扣在地，瓷碗陶碟碎裂满地。父亲林守田静卧里屋门板之上，面色惨白如纸；额间缠布被暗红血水彻底浸透。
母亲枯坐床边，发丝散乱、双眼红肿，死死攥着丈夫的手，低声呢喃不止，满室悲戚。
“爹！”
林天行猛扑上前。林守田费力掀开眼皮，望见儿子慌张模样，干裂唇角勉强扯出一丝笑意。
“没事，爹没事。”

“到底怎么回事？”林天行嗓音发颤，“我爹安分半生，怎会无故被打？”
刘婶轻叹一声，附耳低声道：“你爹今日去铁矿讨薪，赵管事分文不结，反倒污蔑他偷懒怠工，要倒扣三月工钱。你爹上前理论，直接被赵家手下殴打重伤。”
偷懒？
林天行豁然起身，眼底猩红骤起。
他爹在赵家铁矿苦干七年，朝出暮归、风雨无阻，腰身劳损变形，日日透支体魄。这般勤恳之人，竟被安上偷懒的罪名？何其荒唐！
林守田全凭矿上苦力养家，月入二两碎银，堪堪糊口度日。三月前，赵家无故拖欠全员薪资，以矿场周转为由，让工人们静待发落。
老实人最易欺。他爹信以为真，苦苦等候三月。家中粮米耗尽、衣食无着，他才硬着头皮上门讨薪。
七年勤恳，换来一顿拳脚重伤。
“报官了吗？”林天行双拳紧攥，指节泛白。
“报了。”刘婶摇头，眼底尽是寒凉无奈，“官差来过，只草草定性为民间纠纷，勒令你们私下和解，转头便扬长而去。”
私下和解？不过是权贵偏袒的敷衍说辞！
林天行心知肚明其中猫腻。赵家垄断天青城铁矿，大公子赵世杰任职府衙主簿，二公子赵世昌把控铁矿账目。赵家银钱打通半数官吏，朝堂衙门，早已与赵家沆瀣一气。谁会为一介底层矿工，得罪富贵强权？
“我去找他们讨公道！”
“别去！”林守田挣扎欲起，牵扯伤口剧痛难忍，冷汗直冒，“你年纪尚小、势单力薄，斗不过根深蒂固的赵家。”
“难道我们就只能白白受辱、吃这哑巴亏？”
林守田默然不语，疲惫闭眼。沟壑纵横的脸庞上，写满了底层小人物无力的认命。
林天行伫立原地，胸口堵闷难当，窒息般的压抑席卷全身。
---
次日破晓，林天行终究还是踏出家门，直奔城北十里的黑石铁矿。
矿场终年黑烟缭绕、矿石堆积如山。他在铁门处枯守近两时辰，才见赵管事慢悠悠踱步而出。

此人四十有余，肥硕油滑，一身绸缎华服，手捧紫砂茶壶。瞥见少年伫立，眼底瞬间掠过一抹轻蔑。
“赵管事，恳请结清我爹三月工钱。”
content_en:
Winter in Tianqing City always comes early.
Caught off guard, the cold bites the bones and blood.
Lin Tianxing squatted alone on the threshold of the dilapidated Earth Temple in the west of the city. The half piece of steamed bun in the palm of my hand was hard and hard, and it had already become cold.
He raised his eyes and stared at the leaden sky above his head.
The wind in November broke through the broken wall and poured directly into the clothes. The cold wind made my face hurt, and my thin single clothes couldn't resist the biting cold. He curled up tightly, trying his best to lock in the remaining warmth around him.
At the age of fifteen, he was extremely thin and frail, like a weed barely surviving in the cold winter, as weak as the wind.
"Tian Xing!"
Suddenly there was a loud shout at the entrance of the alley, it was the neighbor Aunt Liu, her tone was trembling with panic.
Lin Tianxing suddenly looked up and saw Aunt Liu, wrapped in a thick cotton-padded jacket, staggering towards him, with panic in her eyes. His heart suddenly sank.
"Come back quickly! Something happened to your family!"
Wotou fell to the ground and rolled into the mud. Lin Tianxing had no time to think about it and rushed towards the poor alley in the east of the city.
The walls of his two adobe houses were peeling and dilapidated. At this moment, the outside of the house was full of neighbors, the crowd was dead silent, and the atmosphere was strangely depressed.
When everyone saw him running towards him, they silently made way for a narrow path.
Lin Tianxing rushed through the door, his steps instantly frozen and his whole body stiff and cold.
The house was in disarray.
The old wooden table was upside down and porcelain bowls and dishes were broken all over the floor. His father, Lin Shoutian, was lying quietly on the door panel of the inner room, his face as pale as paper; the cloth on his forehead was completely soaked with dark red blood.
The mother was sitting by the bed, her hair disheveled, her eyes red and swollen, clutching her husband's hand tightly, murmuring in a low voice, and the whole room was filled with sadness.
"Dad!"
Lin Tianxing rushed forward. Lin Shoutian struggled to open his eyelids and saw his son's panic, and managed a smile at the corners of his chapped lips.
"It's okay, dad is okay."
"What's going on?" Lin Tianxing's voice trembled, "My father has been peaceful for most of his life, how could he be beaten for no reason?"
Aunt Liu sighed softly and whispered: "Your father went to the iron mine today to ask for wages. Manager Zhao did not collect any money. Instead, he accused him of slacking off and wanted to deduct three months of wages. Your father came forward to argue and was beaten and seriously injured by the Zhao family's men."
Lazy?
Lin Tianxing stood up suddenly, his eyes suddenly turned scarlet.
His father worked hard at the Zhaojia Iron Mine for seven years, going out and returning at night, rain or shine, and his waist was strained and deformed, and his body was exhausted every day. Such a diligent person was accused of laziness? How ridiculous!
Lin Shoutian supported his family entirely by working as a coolie in the mines. He earned two taels of silver a month, which was enough to survive hand to mouth. Three months ago, the Zhao family owed wages to all employees without any reason, citing the mine's turnover as an excuse to let the workers wait for their pay.
Honest people are the easiest to bully. His father believed it and waited patiently for March. When his family ran out of food and food, he went to ask for wages.
Seven years of hard work resulted in a fist and serious injuries.
"Have you reported to the official?" Lin Tianxing clenched his fists tightly, and his knuckles turned white.
"Reported." Aunt Liu shook her head, her eyes full of cold helplessness, "Official officials came here, and they simply classified it as a civil dispute, ordered you to reconcile privately, and then walked away."
Reconcile privately? It's just a perfunctory talk of favoritism by powerful people!
Lin Tianxing knew there was something fishy about it. The Zhao family has a monopoly on the Tianqingcheng Iron Mine. The eldest son, Zhao Shijie, serves as the chief clerk of the government office, and the second son, Zhao Shichang, controls the iron ore mine accounts. The Zhao family's money has gained access to half of the officials, and the court and government offices have long been in cahoots with the Zhao family. Who would offend the rich and powerful for a low-level miner?
"I'm going to seek justice from them!"
"Don't go!" Lin Shoutian struggled to get up. The pain involved in the wound was unbearable and he broke out in a cold sweat. "You are still young and weak. You cannot defeat the deep-rooted Zhao family."
"Are we just going to be humiliated and suffer the consequences of being dumb?"
Lin Shoutian remained silent and closed his eyes tiredly. The ravaged face is filled with the helpless resignation of the low-level people.
Lin Tianxing stood there, his chest feeling tight and suffocating depression sweeping through his body.
---
At dawn the next day, Lin Tianxing finally stepped out of his house and headed straight to the Black Stone Iron Station ten miles north of the city.mine.
The mine is filled with black smoke all year round and mountains of ore pile up. He stayed at the iron gate for nearly two hours before he saw Manager Zhao walking out slowly.
This man was in his forties, fat and oily, dressed in silk and satin clothes, and holding a purple sand teapot in his hand. Seeing the young man standing there, a flash of contempt flashed across his eyes.
"Manager Zhao, please pay my father three months' wages."
